title: Rename DevKBGraph.edges to edges_by_verb
body: The graph model's method `DevKBGraph.edges(verb)` in `devkb/model.py` has the same name as other `edges` functions and attributes, so its uses are easy to confuse. Rename the method to `edges_by_verb` and update every call of **this** method throughout the repository (extractors, tools, tests). Leave every other `edges` (other functions, attributes, dictionary keys) as it is.
